text_block_list.text:
Today is the Kinko Sho. But
Matikanefukukitaru,
our rival for the
day, has yet to show up.

Fukukitaru is a little late, isn't she? I
wonder
where she could be...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Sorry for keeping you waiting. I wanted
to dress
up in something flashy to make
a grand entrance!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm taking it up a notch, two
notches
even. You see...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I've visited tranquil shrines over a
hundred times!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I went to the heart of the mountains and
stood
beneath a waterfall for
five—no—six minutes!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
And finally, I went to the bargain store
and
brought home a bounty of lucky
goods!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Having absorbed all their lucky power...
I stand
here transformed, as Full Armor
Fukukitaru!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
How was that, Bourbon?! I'm getting
your shtick
right, aren't I?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
...Unable to compute. Please try again
after
resubmitting information.
text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон

text_block_list.text: That's a little intimidating... but... but!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Blockading the path to Т.М. Опера О
stands a
towering wall of fortune.
Мэйсё Дото must do
whatever it takes
to overcome it.
